title: ROS 2 "Failed to parse global arguments" and "Cannot have a value before ros__parameters": params YAML and -p errors, measured
excerpt: What each rcl params-file and -p error means, from missing ros__parameters and tab indentation to InvalidParameterTypeException for 1 vs 1.0, plus the two mistakes that fail silently: a wrong node-name key and arguments before --ros-args. Measured in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
